visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short dark hair, wearing a white wide-brimmed sun hat and black Prada sunglasses, stands in a historic-looking European plaza. She wears a light blue and white vertical-striped blazer over a white shirt and white pants. She holds a small gimbal camera in her left hand and gestures with her right hand while talking to an off-screen person. Pedestrians walk on the cobblestone ground behind her, and large ornate buildings are visible in the background under bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the woman. She continues speaking, using her right hand to point at her cheekbone area beneath her sunglasses to emphasize her point. Her facial expression is serious yet engaged. A black smartwatch with a blue strap is visible on her left wrist. The background shows a portion of a grand building with arches and people strolling by in casual summer attire. (3) The woman removes her large, dark-lensed sunglasses with her right hand to show them to the viewer. She continues her explanation, looking directly into the camera. The focus remains sharp on her while the background shows the vast open space of the plaza and distant figures. She gestures with the sunglasses as she talks about their features. (4) A final static graphic screen appears with a white background and a grey ink-blot texture. It displays the clinic's logo "DRX" and its name in Traditional Chinese and English. Detailed contact information, including a LINE handle, phone number, and two physical addresses in Sanchong and Zhongshan districts, is listed clearly.
